mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalChats, COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(f.user_id, f.username)) AS activeUsers, COALESCE(AVG(f.duration_ms), 0) AS avgResponseTime FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate}

SELECT f.source_type AS sourceType, COUNT(*) AS chatCount, COALESCE(SUM(f.prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(f.completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(all_f.total_tokens) FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact all_f WHERE all_f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(all_f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate}), 0), 1) AS percentage FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY f.source_type ORDER BY totalTokens DESC, chatCount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalChats, COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(f.user_id, f.username)) AS activeUsers FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.prevStartDate} AND #{params.prevEndDate}

SELECT DATE(f.created_at) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(f.prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(f.completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY DATE(f.created_at) ORDER BY DATE(f.created_at)

SELECT COALESCE(f.username, f.user_id) AS username, COUNT(*) AS chatCount, COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY
SUM(f.total_tokens) DESC
COUNT(*) DESC
) AS `rank` FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY COALESCE(f.username, f.user_id) ORDER BY
totalTokens DESC
chatCount DESC
LIMIT #{params.limit}

SELECT f.model AS model, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) AS tokens, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact all_f WHERE all_f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(all_f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate}), 0), 1) AS percentage FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND f.model IS NOT NULL AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY f.model ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN f.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'SUCCESS', 'COMPLETED') THEN '1' ELSE '9' END AS status, CASE WHEN f.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'SUCCESS', 'COMPLETED') THEN '已使用' ELSE '失败' END AS statusName, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact all_f WHERE all_f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(all_f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate}), 0), 1) AS percentage FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY CASE WHEN f.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'SUCCESS', 'COMPLETED') THEN '1' ELSE '9' END, CASE WHEN f.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'SUCCESS', 'COMPLETED') THEN '已使用' ELSE '失败' END ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT r.dataset_id AS datasetId, d.name AS datasetName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) AS usageCount, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN r.llm_flag = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF( SUM(CASE WHEN r.llm_flag = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN r.llm_flag = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS avgSuitability FROM ai_chat_record r LEFT JOIN ai_dataset d ON r.dataset_id = d.id WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND d.id > 100000 AND r.dataset_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE(r.create_time) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY r.dataset_id, d.name ORDER BY usageCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DAYOFWEEK(f.created_at) AS dayOfWeek, HOUR(f.created_at) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(f.created_at), HOUR(f.created_at) ORDER BY dayOfWeek, hour

SELECT f.model AS model, f.duration_ms AS use_time FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND f.model IS NOT NULL AND f.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND f.duration_ms > 0 AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} ORDER BY f.model, f.duration_ms

SELECT DATE(f.created_at) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.token_type = '0' THEN f.total_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS systemTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.token_type = '1' THEN f.total_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS userTokens FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY DATE(f.created_at) ORDER BY DATE(f.created_at)

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN r.websearch_flag = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withSearch, COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) AS total FROM ai_chat_record r WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(r.create_time) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate}

SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, d.name AS deptName, COUNT(*) AS chatCount, COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) = f.user_id AND CAST(u.tenant_id AS CHAR) = f.tenant_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id AND CAST(d.tenant_id AS CHAR) = f.tenant_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND d.dept_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.name ORDER BY chatCount DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT f.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.name AS companyName, COUNT(*) AS chatCount, COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON CAST(t.id AS CHAR) = f.tenant_id WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY f.tenant_id, t.name ORDER BY chatCount DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT f.agent_id AS agentId, a.name AS agentName, f.model AS modelName, COALESCE(SUM(f.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COUNT(*) AS chatCount FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact f LEFT JOIN ai_agent a ON a.id = f.agent_id AND CAST(a.tenant_id AS CHAR) = f.tenant_id AND a.del_flag = '0' WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND f.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE(f.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate} GROUP BY f.agent_id, a.name, f.model ORDER BY totalTokens DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT r.username AS username, u.realName AS realName, u.deptName AS deptName, r.chatCount AS chatCount, r.totalTokens AS totalTokens FROM ( SELECT fact.tenant_id AS tenantId, fact.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(fact.username, fact.user_id) AS username, COUNT(*) AS chatCount, COALESCE(SUM(fact.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact fact WHERE fact.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND COALESCE(fact.username, fact.user_id) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(fact.username, fact.user_id) != ''
AND DATE(fact.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate}
GROUP BY fact.tenant_id, fact.user_id, COALESCE(fact.username, fact.user_id) ) r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_info.userId, user_info.username, user_info.realName, user_info.deptName FROM ( SELECT su.user_id AS userId, su.username, su.name AS realName, sd.name AS deptName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.user_id ORDER BY su.user_id ASC) AS row_num FROM sys_user su INNER JOIN sys_tenant_user stu ON stu.user_id = su.user_id AND stu.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON su.dept_id = sd.dept_id AND sd.del_flag = '0' WHERE su.del_flag = '0' ) user_info WHERE user_info.row_num = 1 ) u ON CAST(u.userId AS CHAR) = r.userId OR (r.userId IS NULL AND r.username = u.username)
WHERE (r.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.keyword}, '%') OR u.realName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY totalTokens DESC, r.username ASC
ORDER BY chatCount DESC, r.username ASC
LIMIT #{params.offset}, #{params.pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT fact.tenant_id AS tenantId, fact.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(fact.username, fact.user_id) AS username FROM ai_conversation_usage_fact fact WHERE fact.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND COALESCE(fact.username, fact.user_id) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(fact.username, fact.user_id) != ''
AND DATE(fact.created_at) BETWEEN #{params.startDate} AND #{params.endDate}
GROUP BY fact.tenant_id, fact.user_id, COALESCE(fact.username, fact.user_id) ) r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_info.userId, user_info.username, user_info.realName FROM ( SELECT su.user_id AS userId, su.username, su.name AS realName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.user_id ORDER BY su.user_id ASC) AS row_num FROM sys_user su INNER JOIN sys_tenant_user stu ON stu.user_id = su.user_id AND stu.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE su.del_flag = '0' ) user_info WHERE user_info.row_num = 1 ) u ON CAST(u.userId AS CHAR) = r.userId OR (r.userId IS NULL AND r.username = u.username)
WHERE (r.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.keyword}, '%') OR u.realName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.keyword}, '%'))

FROM ai_chat_record r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, message_key, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completion_tokens FROM ai_bill WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY tenant_id, message_key ) b ON b.message_key = r.record_id AND b.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, username, name, dept_id FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, username, name, dept_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id, username ORDER BY user_id ASC) AS rn FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0' ) user_rows WHERE rn = 1 ) u ON u.username = r.username AND u.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id AND d.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ai_agent a ON a.id = r.agent_id AND a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND a.del_flag = '0'
